content_zh:
白颜听到白潇这小心翼翼的语气，俨然失笑：“世人皆以为我背叛了二皇子，为何你觉得是二皇子的损失？”
“我相信姐，姐不会背叛他，一定是有人陷害，”少年的神色很是坚定，语气凶狠，“若是让我知道是谁，我一定不会放过她！”
白颜心尖一颤，心里有着说不出的滋味。
前生，她是华夏古武界的传人，从小被灌输的观念便是变强！为了变强，她众叛亲离，最终的结果是在炼制九品丹药时遭遇天雷，身陨魂灭。
好不容易重活一世，她绝不会如前世一样，只顾修炼，而忽略了身边的人。
“对了，”少年从怀里掏出了一个钱袋子，放到了白颜的手上，“你现在怀孕了，需要补充营养，这些银子给你拿着。”
白颜捏着钱袋子，心里发酸：“这些银子哪里的？”
“我……我把娘亲在世时留给我的玉佩给当了。”
白颜的心被揪紧了。
别看她和白潇在外人眼里很风光，事实上，白家经常克扣他们的月钱，就连蓝月带来的那些嫁妆，也都被于蓉拿捏在手里。
偏偏白颜姐弟也很倔强，他们都知道母亲对不起外公，再苦再累，都没有去蓝家寻求过帮助。
蓝家又太过于自信，认为白家不敢苛待白颜姐弟，何况蓝月的那些嫁妆，就足够两姐弟挥霍一生了。
事实上呢？
于蓉的两个女儿穿金戴银，吃的是山珍海味，白颜姐弟却经常会吃不饱饭。
可笑的是，白振祥不会经商，于蓉又大手大脚，白家多年来所动用的，都是蓝月的嫁妆。
至于白潇的玉佩，是蓝月唯一留给他的物品，也是他多年来仅有的念想。
若不是他藏的太深，怕是早被于蓉给收去了。
就在白颜心思百转间，一名丫鬟不问自入，打断了两姐弟相处的时刻。
“大小姐，夫人请你过去一趟。”
“姐。”

白潇急忙握住了白颜的手，眼底满是担忧。
“放心，我不会有事，”白颜安慰的拍了拍白潇的手，向他使了个放心的眼色，这才向着门口走去。
顷刻间，少女磅礴的气势宣泄而出，她红衣倾城，眼神冰冷，每随着她走一步，丫鬟的呼吸就困难了一分，喉咙似被锁住，无法呼吸。
“别忘了，你只是一个丫鬟而已，就算我再不得宠，也是白府的主子，你不问自入，便是不尊重我，那么我便有资格将你乱棍打死！”
丫鬟脸色一白，她是签了卖身契的，因此，哪怕主子要杀了她，她也不得不死！
之前由于白颜太过于懦弱，让她忘记了这一点。
“带路吧。”少女语气冷漠，不容置疑。
“是，大小姐。”
丫鬟再也不敢轻视面前的少女，即便她声名狼藉，发问一个下人还是绰绰有余。
白潇愣愣的看着少女的背影，他总觉得，这几个月来，大姐似乎变了……
变得坚强可靠，让他安心。

content_en:
Bai Yan burst out laughing when she heard Bai Xiao's cautious tone: "Everyone in the world thinks that I betrayed the second prince, why do you think it is the second prince's loss?"
"I believe sister, sister will not betray him. Someone must have framed her," the young man said with a firm expression and a fierce tone, "If I know who it is, I will definitely not let her go!"
Bai Yan's heart trembled, and she felt an indescribable feeling in her heart.
In her previous life, she was a descendant of the ancient Chinese martial arts world, and the concept she had been instilled in her since she was a child was to become stronger! In order to become stronger, she betrayed all her relatives, and the final result was that she was struck by a thunderstorm while refining the ninth-grade elixir, and her body and soul were destroyed.
After finally resurrecting her life, she would never be like her previous life, focusing only on cultivation and ignoring the people around her.
"By the way," the young man took out a money bag from his arms and put it in Bai Yan's hand, "You are pregnant now and need to supplement your nutrition. I will give you the money."
Bai Yan pinched the money bag and felt sad: "Where did this money come from?"
"I...I pawned the jade pendant my mother left for me when she was still alive."
Bai Yan's heart was tightened.
Although she and Bai Xiao were very popular in the eyes of outsiders, in fact, the Bai family often deducted their monthly money, and even the dowry brought by Lan Yue was in Yu Rong's hands.
However, the Baiyan siblings were also very stubborn. They all knew that their mother was sorry for their grandfather, and no matter how hard and tired they were, they never went to the Lan family to seek help.
The Lan family was too confident and believed that the Bai family did not dare to treat the Bai Yan siblings harshly, not to mention Lan Yue's dowry, which was enough for the two siblings to spend a lifetime.
In fact?
Yu Rong's two daughters are dressed in gold and silver and eat delicacies from the mountains and seas, but the Baiyan siblings often don't have enough to eat.
The funny thing is that Bai Zhenxiang doesn't know how to do business, and Yu Rong is extravagant. All the Bai family has spent over the years has been Lan Yue's dowry.
As for Bai Xiao's jade pendant, it is the only thing Lan Yue left to him, and it is also the only thing he has thought about for many years.
If he hadn't hidden it too deeply, he might have been taken away by Yu Rong.
While Bai Yan's mind was spinning, a maid came in without asking, interrupting the moment the two siblings were getting along.
"Miss, madam, please come over."
"Sister."
Bai Xiao hurriedly held Bai Yan's hand, her eyes full of worry.
"Don't worry, I'll be fine," Bai Yan patted Bai Xiao's hand comfortingly, gave him a reassuring look, and then walked towards the door.
In an instant, the girl's majestic momentum was released. She was dressed in red and had cold eyes. Every time she took a step, the maid's breathing became more difficult. Her throat seemed to be locked and she could not breathe.
"Don't forget, you are just a maid. Even if I am no longer favored, you are still the master of the White House. If you don't ask yourself, you disrespect me, then I am qualified to beat you to death with a stick!"
The maid's face turned pale. She had signed a contract of betrayal, so even if the master wanted to kill her, she had to die!
Because Bai Yan was too cowardly before, she forgot this.
"Lead the way." The girl's tone was cold and left no room for doubt.
"Yes, Miss."
The maid no longer dared to look down upon the girl in front of her. Even if she had a bad reputation, it was more than enough to ask a servant.
Bai Xiao stared blankly at the girl's back. He always felt that the eldest sister seemed to have changed in the past few months...
Be strong and reliable and give him peace of mind.
